thought.text: All WARs intact. The API Tomcat is redeploying with `XPLAN_JDBC_URL` set. Waiting for completion:

reasoning_content:
Wait — I just noticed that earlier, when I stopped Tomcat, I ran `rm -rf /opt/tomcat-api/webapps/xplan-*`. That deleted both the expanded directories and the .war files. That's why the redeploy of API Tomcat only deployed the directories. Then I re-copied the 3 API WARs. Okay.

Also, the cleanup I did when I restarted anwendung earlier — I used the same pattern there too, but... let me check: after the first startup failure, I ran the following:
```
for t in dienste anwendung api; do
  for w in /opt/tomcat-$t/webapps/xplan-*; do
    [ -d "$w" ] && rm -rf "$w"
  done
done
```
This only deleted directories (guarded by `[ -d ]`). Good.

The subsequent cleanup: `for t in dienste anwendung api; do for w in /opt/tomcat-$t/webapps/xplan-*; do [ -d "$w" ] && rm -rf "$w"; done; done` — this one also had the -d guard. Good.

But before the API restart I ran: `rm -rf /opt/tomcat-api/webapps/xplan-*` — no -d guard! That's what deleted the API WARs. After that, on the first attempt, I didn't actually re-copy (the command just listed webapps and exited... no wait, actually I did re-copy: "cp /tmp/dist/web/xplan-manager-api.war ... /opt/tomcat-api/webapps/" — yes, it was the first command of this block. Then I restarted, but... hold on, in the block before that I ran shutdown+startup without copying. Then in this last block I copied and restarted again. So it's fine now — the WARs are back (verified by ls).

Dienste and anwendung still have all the WARs. Everything's good.

Now, while the API is redeploying, let me wait about 4 minutes and then do final verification.

action.command:
sleep 240; grep -E "Deployment of web application archive.*finished|Error deploying" /opt/tomcat-api/logs/catalina.out | sed 's/\x1b\[[0-9;]*m//g' | awk '$1" "$2 ~ /^16-Oct-2026 1[01]:5/' | tail -5
echo "=== endpoints ==="
for u in "xplan-manager-api/swagger-ui/index.html" "xplan-validator-api/swagger-ui/index.html" "xplan-dokumente-api/swagger-ui/index.html"; do
  c=$(timeout 30 curl -s -o /dev/null -w '%{http_code}' "http://localhost:8080/$u"); echo "  $c  /$u"
done
